prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Next: Tray Controls", "Master Your Desktop Pet Tray Controls", "Learn how to toggle visibility, interact, and manage your companion from your system tray.", "Right-click the tray icon to summon or hide your pet at any time."]
1: ["Select your companion base type"]
2: ["Test pet tray controls"]
3: []
4: ["Signing into your existing account will automatically load and restore all your saved pets."]
5: ["Your pet is rendering in the background. We will notify you when it is ready on your desktop!"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live! Find It in Your System Tray", "Click the pet tray icon anytime to speak, customize, or temporarily hide your desktop companion."]
7: ["Your chosen path and pet creations are automatically linked to your session."]
8: ["Receive a desktop notification whenever your pet starts up or sleeps."]
9: ["Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos", "For best custom pet generation, use well-lit images with a clear subject centered in the frame."]

verdicts.problem: Asks the user to upload photos, which can collect personal information.
